consequence.statement: the parameter tab no longer encounters a null reference error when used with a hydrator

original.statement: A null reference error in the UI parameter tab when used with a hydrator has been fixed.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the UI parameter tab no longer hits a null reference error with the hydrator, and nothing that worked before changes or breaks.

corrected.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes a null reference error in the UI parameter tab when used with the hydrator; operators need to do nothing about it.

decision.reason: [ev-7b73f24193c6] lists this only as a UI bug fix in the changelog: the parameter tab had a null reference error when used with the hydrator, and that is now fixed. The fix applies when the operator upgrades, with no action needed. Nothing that worked before now behaves differently, and nothing fails, is rejected or needs review. So behavior-change with review-required and medium severity overstates it; the consequence for operators is none (informational).
